entries.label: Round face · short hair
entries.description: The face features a soft, rounded outline with gentle cheekbones, a subtly defined jawline, and a slightly pointed chin. Eyebrows are naturally arched and full, framing almond-shaped eyes with a warm, light brown hue. The nose is straight with a slight bridge, and lips are full, slightly parted in a gentle smile, revealing even teeth. Skin appears smooth and evenly toned with a natural sheen.
